create_EMA_callback: create an EMA callback with a decay value to maintain moving averages of model parameters during training
apply_ema_weights: apply EMA weight updates to a LightningModule by averaging original and EMA weights with the configured decay
replace_model_weights_with_EMA: replace model weights with EMA weights before validation or testing to evaluate using smoothed parameters
save_checkpoint_with_EMA: save a model checkpoint that includes both original weights and EMA weights using EMAModelCheckpoint callback
load_EMA_weights_from_checkpoint: load EMA weights from a saved checkpoint to resume training with previously computed moving averages
